compute_energy: compute system-level energy from node embeddings and an energy block module
compute_forces: compute forces as the negative gradient of energy with respect to atomic positions
compute_forces_and_stress: compute forces and stress tensor from energy using autograd on positions and cell
compute_hessian: compute the Hessian matrix as the second derivative of energy with respect to positions
reduce_node_to_system: reduce node-level values to system-level by summing over nodes in each system
